Senior Backend Engineer
Acme Payments · Remote (Europe)

About the role
You'll join the Ledger team and own services that move money for 1,200 platforms.

What you'll do
- Design and build idempotent, well-tested services in TypeScript on Node.js
- Own the performance and correctness of our Postgres-backed ledger
- Review code and mentor engineers earlier in their careers

Requirements
- 5+ years of professional backend development experience
- Strong TypeScript and Node.js skills
- Solid understanding of relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL (indexing, transactions, query plans)
- Experience designing and operating distributed systems at scale
- Clear written communication — we are remote-first and write things down

Nice to have
- Experience with payments, billing or accounting systems
- Go
- Experience with event sourcing

We offer a competitive salary, equity and 30 days of holiday.
